authorization.basis: The owner supplied the exact local source path after requesting continued step-by-step implementation toward a usable HD particle studio.

objective: Revise the successful but visually coarse particle proof into a faithful, high-density, image-derived blAIne wordmark effect suitable for native Steam Deck review and HD production-oriented output.
required_preflight: Read the complete GACP and target-repository AGENTS.md files and applicable governing baselines.
Verify repository identity, remote state, authoritative main baseline, prior proof commit, and clean/allowed worktree state.
Verify that /home/deck/Pictures/Screenshots/blAIne.png exists, is a readable PNG, and record its byte count, pixel dimensions, color/alpha characteristics, and SHA-256 digest.
Stop without implementation if the source asset is missing, unreadable, not the intended blAIne artwork, or materially inconsistent with the approved visual target.
Use the prior proof commit as the reusable implementation baseline only where consistent with this revision; preserve main unchanged.
authorized_scope: Create the governed revision branch without rewriting or deleting the prior proof branch.
Copy the verified owner-provided PNG into an appropriate tracked reference-asset path on the revision branch and record its provenance and SHA-256 digest.
Replace the provisional 35x7 hand-authored wordmark mask with deterministic targets derived from the actual PNG pixels, including source color and opacity.
Implement literal one-particle-per-meaningful-visible-pixel mode and at least one adaptive-density mode.
Use resolution-independent normalized target coordinates and aspect-ratio-preserving placement.
Present at native Steam Deck 1280x800 drawable resolution by default and respond correctly to actual framebuffer size and window resizing.
Support a minimum 1920x1080 production-oriented render or deterministic frame capture path without changing the artwork proportions.
Render particles efficiently in batches or another demonstrably scalable method; do not issue an independent heavyweight draw submission per particle.
Use smooth particle primitives with appropriate opacity/anti-aliasing and preserve pale white/gray outer letters plus cyan/blue AI coloration.
Implement a bounded glow treatment for the blue AI region without allowing glow to destroy wordmark legibility.
Preserve deterministic scatter-to-assembly motion, assembled hold, restart, and exit behavior.
Provide a simple way to switch or launch literal and adaptive-density modes for owner comparison.
Add focused tests for image decoding/mask extraction, deterministic target generation, coordinate scaling, density selection, and any CPU-to-render-data conversion introduced.
Update only minimal build and usage documentation needed for this slice.
Capture review evidence at 1280x800 for both literal and adaptive-density assembled states and at least one 1920x1080 deterministic output.
Measure and record particle counts, frame behavior/performance on the Steam Deck, commands run, validation results, changed files, and remote synchronization.
visual_acceptance_requirements: The assembled result must be immediately recognizable as the supplied blAIne artwork, preserving its actual contours, proportions, spacing, and stylized letterforms.
The result must not be an enlarged low-resolution grid, generic font substitute, hand-authored approximation, or claim of per-pixel representation when source pixels were not actually used.

Literal mode must create one target particle for each defined meaningful visible source pixel under a documented alpha rule; any deliberate transparent/background exclusion must be deterministic and reported.
Adaptive mode must retain the same recognizable silhouette while making particle density adjustable or explicitly selectable.
Native 1280x800 evidence must show the full intended wordmark without clipping, missing regions caused by incorrect scaling, or reliance on a 960x540-only surface.
Build/test PASS alone is insufficient; final visual acceptance remains an owner decision after evidence and runtime review.
exclusions: No deletion or rewriting of the earlier dot-matrix proof.
No general-purpose editor, timeline editor, audio system, audio reactivity, export pipeline, AI tooling, networking, asset-library architecture, GPU particle simulation, or broad renderer redesign.
No unrelated cleanup, dependency expansion, or architecture work.
No claim that 4K real-time performance is established.
No final substantive acceptance on behalf of the owner.
validation_and_result: Perform clean configure/build and all repository tests.
Repeat deterministic tests and target generation sufficiently to prove stable results.
Run the demo in the Steam Deck graphical environment at 1280x800 in both required density modes.
Generate and inspect the required native and 1080p evidence captures.
Validate changed-file scope, git diff --check, branch publication, and local/remote commit identity.

Publish a durable GACP result receipt with asset digest/dimensions, implementation commit and branch, exact changed files, particle counts by mode, test/runtime/performance evidence, screenshot paths or durable evidence references, limitations, blockers, and the next owner visual-review gate.
Stop after branch publication and GACP result publication; do not merge.
stop_conditions: Required source asset cannot be verified.
Required implementation would materially exceed the authorized scope.
The implementation cannot produce source-derived targets or native 1280x800 evidence.
Validation fails or repository state differs materially from the declared baseline.
An unexpected sensitive, licensing, or publication concern is detected.
Any merge, destructive action, or new architectural decision becomes necessary.
next_gate: Owner visual review and acceptance, revision, or rejection of the HD image-derived result. Merge requires separate explicit authorization.
